payload.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] In an engine repo, kit config shows fold_on_merge with the home the engine reads.
- [ ] Setting it in one place changes what the next install wires.
payload.description:
## Trigger

When a person reads the fold setting with the kit config command in an engine repo, I want it to name the one place that decides it, so I can change the fold without guessing which file wins.

## Context

Found by the basicly-9pyaygb.7 lane: the engine reads [tracker] fold_on_merge from basicly.toml, while kit config names the post-merge hook as its home.
payload.requirements: One home for the fold setting, read by the engine and the kit.
payload.title: fold on merge has two homes in an engine repo

payload.name: close_reason

payload.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] A server whose kit files changed since start answers each data route with a refusal that names the restart command.
- [ ] The page shows that refusal, not an empty board.
payload.description:
## Trigger

When the tracker page runs while the kit and the ledger template change under it, I want it to say that it is out of date and name the restart command, so I can tell a stale server from a dead tracker.

## Context

2026-09-25: the server on 8765 started in the morning. After basicly-9pyaygb.4 added the prefix key to template.json, every data route answered 422 'template.json names unknown key(s) prefix' while the page itself answered 200. The owner read it as dead. A restart fixed it.
payload.requirements: The server compares the kit it loaded with the kit on disk.
payload.title: a running tracker server refuses a newer ledger template

payload.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] The printed ship confirm command, run at once, approves ship.
- [ ] A test drives classify and ship without a terminal using only the printed commands.
payload.description:
## Trigger

When a person runs the loop without a terminal and the ship checkpoint prints a confirm command, I want that exact command to work, so I can finish a loop the way the output says.

## Context

The 2026-09-25 tutorial walk: loop run --runner manual stopped at ship and printed loop run ... --confirm 7659642c. Run at once, it refused with 'invalid or expired confirm code'. The classify checkpoint accepted the same form. policy checkpoint ship --approve --confirm, then one more loop run, finished it.
payload.requirements: Every printed confirm command works as printed.
payload.title: the ship checkpoint refuses its own printed confirm code

payload.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Neither server calls a name lookup when it binds.
- [ ] On macos-latest the listener test takes under 5 s and the journey test passes.
payload.description:
## Trigger

When a customer on macOS starts the board, I want it to serve at once, so I can open the tracker page without a 30-second wait that reads as a hang.

## Context

quality-gates failed on macos-latest on every push since cc8c86e3: the consumer journey test waits 30 s for the port line and the board printed none. test_board_serve's bind-and-stop test takes 35.6 s on macOS in every run, green ones included. Both servers bind through http.server.HTTPServer.server_bind, which calls socket.getfqdn(host); that reverse lookup is the suspected delay.
payload.requirements: The bind path does no network name lookup.
payload.title: the board takes 30 s to start on macos
